bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
log="deploy/state/video-two-topic-20261123/build-classify.log"
test -s "$log" || exit 41
if grep -Eqi '(Dockerfile.*not found|failed to read dockerfile)' "$log"; then exit 71; fi
if grep -Eqi '(failed to resolve source metadata|pull access denied|manifest unknown|not found.*sha256|error pulling image)' "$log"; then exit 72; fi
if grep -Eqi '(permission denied|cannot connect to the Docker daemon)' "$log"; then exit 73; fi
if grep -Eqi '(failed to compute cache key|not found:.*package.json|failed to calculate checksum)' "$log"; then exit 74; fi
if grep -Eqi '(failed to solve.*process|process.*did not complete successfully)' "$log"; then exit 75; fi
if grep -Eqi '(read.*context|path.*not found|not found.*Dockerfile)' "$log"; then exit 76; fi
if grep -Eqi '(failed to solve)' "$log"; then exit 77; fi
exit 78
